rationale: All runs are feasible (hold >= +0.07 ns, slew/cap far under the bar), so constraints are not binding. period_frac is already at its 0.45 floor (7.02 ns), so gains must come from repair over-achieving: raising setup margins 0.18/0.09 to 0.35/0.25 cut T_eff 6.637 to 6.408, and runs beat their repair aim by 0.2-0.7 ns. Setting 1: the same best recipe (AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, both post-GRT repairs, cap213) with both margins maxed at 0.4. Setting 2: identical but a more compact floorplan (util 40, density 55%, which routed cleanly on this design in ocs_blitter) to cut wire load on critical nets, testing floorplan as the next lever once margins are exhausted.
